title: 7" springform pans
text: 7" springform pans. I purchased 2 of these because they are reported to be stainless and I wanted a longer lasting pan.  I still handwash - hopeful that it extends the life of the pan.  I bought the size that will fit into my large pressure cooker. They are pretty close to 7".  I haven't actually baked with them yet, but they are very nice looking pans - sturdy - not super heavy.  Shiny stainless looking metal.  The clips are sturdy and work.  Having said all of this,  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
